summary_en: WiLLDo Inc. to delist from TOKYO PRO Market (delisting effective 2026-08-27) and transfer all shares to SIVA Corporation, becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. Share transfer scheduled 2026-09-11. SIVA is a vertical-software holding company established 2024-08; will conduct PMI while preserving WiLLDo's management approach and culture. Synergies anticipated through integration with SIVA Group company Squad (SaaS/advertising platform).
title_en: Notice of Delisting Application of Company Shares on TOKYO PRO Market and Complete Share Transfer to SIVA Corporation (Making a Wholly Owned Subsidiary)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-29, WiLLDo Inc. (ticker 5617, TOKYO PRO Market) announced that its board of directors and an extraordinary general shareholders' meeting approved an application for delisting from TOKYO PRO Market and a full share transfer to SIVA Corporation. Following delisting (effective 2026-08-27), all shareholders will transfer their shares to SIVA, making WiLLDo a wholly owned subsidiary. The share transfer is scheduled for 2026-09-11. SIVA is a vertical-software holding company (established 2024-08, headquartered Tokyo) that operates a group of industry-specialized software businesses, conducts equal-footing PMI, and cultivates growth through synergies among group companies. WiLLDo, founded 2001 and listed on TOKYO PRO Market in December 2023, provides cloud services to the beauty/aesthetics industry. Management expects to strengthen ad/marketing support services for the aesthetics sector through collaboration with SIVA Group company Squad (a SaaS/advertising platform provider) while preserving WiLLDo's existing management philosophy and culture. The transaction was executed following due diligence. Japan M&A Center is serving as J-Adviser and will continue advisory services through delisting.
